name: ICAN (International Campaign to Abolish Nuclear Weapons)
summary: A Geneva-based Swiss association, founded in 2007, that leads a coalition of over 700 partner organisations in more than 100 countries campaigning to prohibit and eliminate nuclear weapons. It won the 2017 Nobel Peace Prize for its work towards the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons, and now presses states to join and implement the treaty and campaigns against nuclear deterrence, nuclear weapons spending and investment in the weapons' producers.
